Meerkat Finance is a yield aggregator. Meerkat Finance runs on the BNB Smart Chain. Meerkat Finance offers auto-compounding vaults that reinvest farming rewards.

Terra is a public blockchain platform built around stablecoins. Terra issued the algorithmic stablecoin UST alongside the LUNA token. Terra's UST lost its peg and collapsed in May 2022.

dForce is a decentralized lending protocol. dForce is deployed on the Ethereum blockchain. dForce issues the USDx stablecoin.
